boundary.description: From the junction of Longford Road West and Nelstrop Road North, E along Longford Road West, Windmill Lane to the Reddish – Brinnington Railway. S along the railway to and S along River Tame to the point opposite Lune Way. Then by a beeline SW to and W along Willow Avenue, N along Reddish Road, Birkdale Road, SE along Greg Street, E along Whitehill Street, then N along Manchester Road, Broadstone Road and Nelstrop Road to its junction with Carnforth Road. Then along a footpath to Black Brook and by a beeline to and N along Manchester – Stockport District boundary to the junction of Longford Road West and Nelstrop Road North.
